title: Project Jupiter, the New Mexico data center for which Oracle made major financial commitments, faces power and permitting hurdles, exposing Oracle's AI risks (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Project Jupiter, the New Mexico data center for which Oracle made major financial commitments, faces power and permitting hurdles, exposing Oracle's AI risks — Oracle sent a force majeure notice to developer, has removed a key partner and faces local resistance in ‘Project Jupiter’
